source_identity.candidate_source_policy: One uncommitted bounded prototype was built atop the exact control tree and fully reverted after its directional gate failed.

hypothesis: An exact-shape AVX-512VL whole-transform executor could close the residual K=1000,R=200,64-KiB legacy-high encode gap by keeping serial transform control and fixed-coefficient expansion inside one ISA translation unit.

prototype.scope: GF16 legacy_high_v1 only; exact K=1000,R=200,T=256; dense full parity; AUTO-selected AVX-512VL; two 32768-byte execution tiles from one 65536-byte public shard.
implementation: One optional Ops callback executed four shifted 256-point inverse transforms and the requested 200-output forward prefix.
All transform-stage control was serial and used direct intra-translation-unit calls.
Each fixed GF16 nibble-table coefficient was expanded once per pair range and retained in YMM registers across that range.
The established two-tile layout and final inverse split-XOR accumulation were preserved.

static_audit.coefficient_expansion: Eight 16-byte nibble rows were broadcast once before each prepared pair-range byte loop.

correctness.legacy_parity: Every byte of all 200 transmitted 65536-byte parity shards matched the old leo_encode API.
correctness.independent_oracle: The first GF16 parity symbol matched direct Lagrange interpolation over the legacy coordinate map.
correctness.production_route: The exact AUTO encode executed two whole-transform callbacks, one for each 32768-byte tile.
correctness.fallback_routes: Sparse and partial-output encodes executed zero whole-transform callbacks and retained their established path.

focused_asan_ubsan.runtime_policy: ASan leak detection, halt-on-error, and abort-on-error; UBSan halt-on-error, abort-on-error, and stack traces

validation.reduced_field_build_install_consumer_mat: 1/1 passed for GF8-only and GF16-only variants
validation.fuzzing: Not run by request; this optimization pass used deterministic compatibility, direct algebra, boundary, and focused sanitizer tests.

directional_method.purpose: Fast fail screen before spending a quiet exact-main campaign.
directional_method.raw_hash_definition: SHA-256 of each canonical JSON normalized invocation object: sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN; fields are label, encode_us, samples, digests, resolved, and stderr.

decision.kill_reason: The candidate was 1.92 percent slower directionally and therefore failed both the no-regression condition and the required 5 percent improvement threshold.
decision.next_step: Do not repeat another isolated whole-executor/table-preparation rewrite for this cell without a materially different memory-traffic hypothesis. Resume broader paper-algorithm and dispatcher work instead.
